Short name:
Molecules formed in living cells and involved in life processes
The cell's organic macromolecules build up the cell's structure, preserve the cell's genetic information, catalyze the cell's chemical reactions, and function as an energy reserve.
The molecules are in the form of polymers made up of several monomers. Their mutual order and placement give the cell its properties. The composition varies between different cells.
